product_metadata.title: Tempur-Pedic TEMPUR-Embrace Pillow Soft Feel, Standard, White
features: TEMPUR-PEDIC HUGGABLE PILLOW—This soft pillow features a unique star-shaped design and legendary TEMPUR material, for a stomach sleeping pillow unlike any other.
PERSONALIZED COMFORT—TEMPUR material in this huggable pillow conforms to your head, neck, and shoulders for better alignment while you sleep.
PERFECTED FOR YOU—Expertly engineered to relieve pressure and provide personalized support throughout the night, and return to shape in the morning.
DURABLE & RELIABLE—Adaptive TEMPUR material never loses its shape, offering superior support and alignment year after year.
description: Wrap your arms around legendary comfort and support with the TEMPUR-Embrace Pillow. This soft pillow uses the same material found in our mattresses to give you transforming night’s sleep. We’ve designed this huggable pillow with a star shape to comfort stomach sleepers while providing conforming support and superior alignment. You’ll get the soft feel and comfort you crave without sacrificing the support you need, all in a stomach sleeping pillow made unlike any other.
